description: This file defines the UriInterface interface in the PSR HTTP Message standard, specifying methods for URI components and manipulation, used primarily for HTTP request handling.

classes.name: UriInterface
classes.description: Interface representing a URI with methods to access and modify URI components immutably, following RFC 3986 standards.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Retrieves the URI scheme component, normalized to lowercase, or empty string if not present.

methods.name: getAuthority
methods.description: Retrieves the authority component in '[user-info@]host[:port]' format, or empty string if not present.

methods.name: getUserInfo
methods.description: Retrieves user information in 'username[:password]' format, or empty string if not present.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Retrieves the host component, normalized to lowercase, or empty string if not present.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Retrieves the port as an integer if non-standard, null if default or not present.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Retrieves the URI path, percent-encoded, supporting absolute, rootless, or empty paths.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Retrieves the query string, percent-encoded, or empty string if not present.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Retrieves the URI fragment, percent-encoded, or empty string if not present.

methods.name: withScheme
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified scheme, supporting 'http' and 'https'.

methods.name: withUserInfo
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified user info, including optional password.

methods.name: withHost
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified host.

methods.name: withPort
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified port, or null to remove.

methods.name: withPath
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified path.

methods.name: withQuery
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified query string.

methods.name: withFragment
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified URI fragment.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the full URI as a string, properly concatenated with delimiters.
